🌞 What's in store for the rest of the weekend and the start of the working week? 🥶

📈 High pressure comes to dominate the country, bringing mostly settled conditions.

🌦️ But there will still be some cloud and showers about, especially over the next few days in the eastern North Island.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
